updates.ограничения: PainDiffusion synthesizes facial-expression trajectories conditioned on stimulus and configuration; it does not classify pain. BioVid Part C has 87 participants (61 training, 26 validation). A separate evaluation with 18 Japanese rehabilitation clinicians rated a virtual avatar driven by an elbow device; the 31.2% +/- 4.8% win rate measures perceived video realism against ground truth, not pain-recognition accuracy, real-patient training effectiveness or treatment benefit.
